nodes.label: Why generic POS / ERP software fails in this domain:
nodes.norm_label: why generic pos / erp software fails in this domain:

nodes.label: Financial Leakage Prevention Principle
nodes.rationale: Never let stock expire unnoticed; surface earliest-expiring batches by default.

nodes.label: Store Server Deployment Model
nodes.rationale: One designated always-on local machine runs the Node.js API and local PostgreSQL. All LAN devices talk directly to it. Rejected full multi-master (too complex N-way conflict resolution) and cloud-only (requires reliable internet which small-town UP cannot guarantee). This makes NFR-005 achievable.

nodes.label: Outbox Sync Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every write is recorded as an entry in sync_outbox in the same transaction. Background sync worker pushes unsent entries to the other node with backoff. Guarantees no write is silently lost. Stock changes use deltas not absolute values to avoid overwrite conflicts.

nodes.label: Delta-Based Stock Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Stock quantity changes applied as deltas (+/-), not absolute values. batch_stock_events is the source of truth, quantity_remaining is a maintained cache. Two concurrent sales against the same batch on different nodes both apply correctly.

nodes.label: Invoice Numbering Strategy
nodes.rationale: Per-node reserved block of invoice numbers to prevent collisions across devices. Store Server owns numbering by default. Cloud node gets pre-allocated ranges. Format: INV-{store_code}-{node_id}-{sequence} or range reservation for GST compliance.

nodes.label: Layered Frontend Architecture
nodes.rationale: Strict separation: UI -> State -> Service -> Repository. UI reads from state, calls service methods. Services call repositories. Repositories are swappable interfaces (mock now, API later). This enforces clean boundaries and allows backend swap without UI changes.

nodes.label: The Clinical Console Design System
nodes.rationale: Engineered for high-density, high-focus pharmaceutical workflows. Emphasizes high contrast, crisp hairline separators, tabular numeric alignments, tight keyboard-navigable spatial rhythm. Eliminates extraneous decorative flourishes in favor of information density.

nodes.label: Statutory Violet Rule
nodes.rationale: Violet (#7c3aed) is strictly reserved for Schedule H/H1/X regulated drugs and prescription compliance badges. Never used for general branding or decorative accents.

nodes.label: Keyboard-First Billing
nodes.rationale: All billing workflows must be fully operable via keyboard. Keyboard shortcuts minimize mouse dependency for trained staff at high-rush counter environments.

nodes.label: Speed Over Polish Principle
nodes.rationale: Counter-billing tool used dozens of times a day. Every extra click has a daily cost. Optimize for keyboard-driven, minimal-click workflows on desktop.

nodes.label: Sub-Second Speed Principle
nodes.rationale: Every frequent counter action must be executable in under 2 keypresses without lifting hands from the keyboard.

nodes.label: Low-End Hardware Target
nodes.rationale: Target hardware: 4 GB RAM, older CPU, integrated graphics, HDD, 1366x768 display, unstable internet. This drives all performance requirements including minimal JS bundle size, virtual scrolling for large tables, avoiding expensive animations.

nodes.label: NUMERIC for Money/Quantity
nodes.rationale: Money/quantity columns use NUMERIC, never FLOAT, to avoid rounding errors in GST and stock math.

nodes.label: UUID Primary Keys Convention
nodes.rationale: UUID instead of auto-increment integers because two nodes (Store Server, Cloud) can both create rows independently; UUIDs avoid PK collisions across nodes.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key Header
nodes.rationale: Write endpoints that create financial/stock records accept an optional Idempotency-Key header so a retried request after a flaky LAN blip doesn't double-create a bill.

nodes.label: Flat Hairline Rule
nodes.rationale: Containers achieve separation through 1px solid border tokens and background contrast rather than elevation shadows, preserving visual sharpness under bright pharmacy counter lighting.

nodes.label: Tabular Money Rule
nodes.rationale: All currency amounts, batch numbers, and stock quantities must be rendered in tabular monospace font to guarantee vertical decimal alignment.

nodes.label: Zero Compliance Compromise Principle
nodes.rationale: Never permit sale finalization of regulated drugs without required medical audit details.
